one_liner: HubSpot has a broad REST API (api.hubapi.com) with OAuth2 plus static tokens, free developer accounts, and a vendor-run MCP server; some endpoints are tier-gated.
auth_notes: The fetched pages confirm OAuth authorization URLs for apps and legacy private apps with scopes. The draft's claims about service keys, 30-minute token expiry and refresh tokens were not on the supplied pages. Private-app tokens are the static-token option.
access_notes: No fee for developers to build on HubSpot, and a developer account and test account are available. Some scopes and endpoints require a higher account tier (e.g. custom objects need Enterprise), but most core CRM scopes are 'Any account'. The page notes that API usage counts toward the plan's included API capacity.
blocker_notes: Minor: some endpoints and scopes depend on the customer's account tier, and date-based API versioning must be tracked. The legacy private-app deprecation in the draft is not shown on the supplied pages.
